description: CRC32/xxHash-style hashing is a common NIF reason. Blocked on defk lacking band/bor/bxor/bsl/bsr. Compare with :erlang.crc32 (a BIF) to show when the BEAM already has a native answer.

comments.text: Covered by later examples, closing as superseded: examples/hashes.exs (defk-9p6.20: xxHash64, Murmur3, SipHash, CRC32C, with :erlang.crc32 beside at 40 GB/s) and examples/geohash_crc.exs (defk-52v.4: table-driven CRC-16/CRC-64 kernels vs the crc NIF, :erlang.crc32 100x faster). Bitwise ops landed in defk-w38. Both show when the BEAM already has a native answer.

title: Example: checksum/hash over binaries (needs bitwise ops in defk)
